note.zh-cn: 需在致命伤提交前拦截并保留死亡归属，再延迟 4 秒处决；现有受击事件发生得太晚。
note.en: Requires interception before lethal damage commits and preservation of kill attribution; post-hit events are too late.

note.zh-cn: 可按 breed/tag 乘算初始生命；monster_health_150 模板选择三种普通怪物。
note.en: Initial health can be multiplied by breed/tag; monster_health_150 selects the three regular monsters.

note.zh-cn: 同上；monster_health_200 提供 ×2，两个模板互斥。
note.en: As above; monster_health_200 gives double health and excludes the other health template.

note.zh-cn: ammo_scarcity 将原生拾弹结算结果乘 0.75，与浩劫修正叠乘。
note.en: ammo_scarcity multiplies the native pickup result by 0.75, including existing Havoc adjustments.

note.zh-cn: 已支持 50% 空弹药；医疗包和部署箱失效仍需分别接入使用流程。
note.en: 50% empty ammo is implemented; failed medical/deployable crates need separate use-path adapters.

note.zh-cn: coherent_medic 每秒恢复生命和腐化各 0.3，遵守原生禁疗与连携计数。
note.en: coherent_medic restores 0.3 health and corruption each second, respecting native prevention and coherency.

note.zh-cn: coherent_defence 提供连携时 35% 韧性减伤。
note.en: coherent_defence supplies 35% toughness damage reduction in coherency.

note.zh-cn: 可用 interval 调度，但 4–8 个预警圈、轨迹、阵营与护甲伤害需专门弹幕适配；尚未实现。
note.en: Interval scheduling exists; telegraphs, shell trajectories, faction and armor damage require a dedicated artillery adapter.

note.zh-cn: deeper_wounds 提供玩家承伤 ×1.1。
note.en: deeper_wounds multiplies player damage taken by 1.1.

note.zh-cn: corrupting_touch 对读取该原生属性的腐化来源乘 1.3。
note.en: corrupting_touch applies 1.3 to corruption paths consuming this native stat.

note.zh-cn: 可施加和续期已支持的敌方燃烧状态；全部环境火焰永不熄灭及所有层数永久保留未实现。
note.en: Supported enemy burn statuses can be applied/renewed; permanent environmental fire and all-stack persistence are not implemented.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: 可对普通可生成敌人实施受限处决；不能据此保证全敌人秒杀或直接改任务胜负。
note.en: Restricted execution of ordinary spawnable enemies exists; universal kills and forced mission victory do not.

note.zh-cn: 可死亡后请求不同敌人增援；原地缩小模型、继承骨骼/行为/血量的分裂需额外适配。
note.en: Death-triggered reinforcement is supported; corpse-local scaled clones with inherited behavior need further work.

note.zh-cn: slow_feet 已覆盖距离、速度；原图所有闪避恢复速度的统一 -10% 未完整覆盖。
note.en: slow_feet covers distance/speed; uniform reduction of every dodge recovery timer is not covered.

note.zh-cn: elite_endurance 对原生标签 elite 的敌人增加 40% 初始生命。
note.en: elite_endurance adds 40% initial health to native elite-tagged enemies.

interfaces: pickup spawning; level props; medicae interactions

note.zh-cn: 现接口可生成拾取物，不能统一禁止地图预置物、掉落与医疗站；需分来源拦截。
note.en: Current actions create pickups; removing authored loot, drops and medicae requires source-specific interception.

note.zh-cn: 增加韧性承伤不等于改变满韧性近战生命泄漏比例；需适配原生伤害拆分。
note.en: Increasing toughness damage is not equivalent to changing melee health bleedthrough; requires native damage-split work.

note.zh-cn: battle_fervour 实现 0.1% 能量、500 层、30 秒共享续期；原图防御增益和独立层计时未实现。
note.en: battle_fervour implements 0.1% power, 500 stacks and shared 30s refresh; defence and per-stack timers remain absent.

note.zh-cn: 禁止死亡后救援需接入重生与任务救援流程，不能用普通属性可靠替代。
note.en: Disabling post-death rescue requires respawn/rescue manager integration.

note.zh-cn: split_reinforcements 是精英死亡后有限次请求两个行尸；未实现每种敌人的原地分裂。
note.en: split_reinforcements requests two poxwalkers after elite deaths with caps; it is not universal corpse cloning.

note.zh-cn: 个人照明和敌人感知是不同系统；需限定范围并同步各端。
note.en: Flashlights and AI detection are separate systems requiring scoped adapters and client synchronization.

note.zh-cn: 可以在玩家附近生成箱子；指定地图补给箱开启时必掉两箱尚未接入。
note.en: Crates can be dropped near players; guaranteed contents of specific map containers are not integrated.

note.zh-cn: 附近群体伤害动作不能精确代替受击前的伤害分摊、远距离判定与倒地规则。
note.en: Group damage actions cannot reproduce exact pre-damage redistribution, separation and downed-player rules.

note.zh-cn: 支持限定列表里的敌人与拾取物概率动作；爆桶和任意道具不在现接口内，随机互斥分支仍需扩展。
note.en: Bounded enemy/pickup chance actions exist; arbitrary props/barrels and exclusive outcome branching need extensions.

note.zh-cn: 敌人攻击中移动需逐行为树/动画改造，单独移速属性不足以实现。
note.en: Moving during stationary enemy attacks requires behavior and animation changes, not just speed stats.

note.zh-cn: ranged_monster_shield 对 monster 标签设远程承伤倍率为零；特殊绕行伤害路径除外。
note.en: ranged_monster_shield sets monster ranged damage multiplier to zero; bypassing damage paths are unaffected.

note.zh-cn: 闪电表现、命中选择、保留任务所有权的变形尚未实现；HED 新增怪物不等同原位变形。
note.en: Lightning, hit selection and ownership-preserving transformation are absent; HED reinforcement is not transformation.

note.zh-cn: 原生友伤许可与伤害配置需专门适配；对队友额外扣血不是等价实现。
note.en: Native friendly-fire permissions/profiles need a dedicated adapter; extra teammate health damage is not equivalent.

note.zh-cn: 可组合概率持续扣血，但原生玩家流血、狂战/Boss 加倍、绕韧概率需专门状态适配。
note.en: Chance-based health ticks can approximate it; native player bleeding and class-specific bypass rules need adapters.

note.zh-cn: 同 32 行；可以调整概率，未提供精确原图流血机制。
note.en: As row 32; probabilities are configurable but the exact bleeding mechanism is not provided.

note.zh-cn: 同 32 行；更高概率不改变所缺失的玩家流血适配。
note.en: As row 32; increased probability does not supply the missing native player-bleed adapter.

interfaces: minion FX; death callback; liquid/gas area

note.zh-cn: 生成时冒烟及死亡毒气区域需要可同步的特效与区域伤害生命周期。
note.en: Spawn smoke and death gas require synchronized effects and area-damage lifecycles.

interfaces: spawn replacement; loot replacement; seeded pool

note.zh-cn: 已有确定种子的配置抽取，但全局替换原生敌人与拾取结果需新增来源适配及兼容规则。
note.en: Seeded library selection exists; global spawn/loot replacement needs dedicated source adapters and compatibility rules.

note.zh-cn: 不会通过 DIY 改写玩家装备和正式天赋；临时隔离构筑也需独立、可恢复的适配。
note.en: DIY does not rewrite official items/talents; temporary build isolation needs a separate reversible adapter.

note.zh-cn: 弹药量翻倍和扣弹可做；同时影响手雷、取得结果转为扣当前一半需要拾取事件前适配。
note.en: Ammo scaling/removal exists; grenade pickup changes and replacing a pickup with a current-stock penalty need interception.

interfaces: weapon action state; charge timing; self damage

note.zh-cn: 伤害倍率可改，但蓄力不自动释放、充能曲线和自伤时点需武器动作适配。
note.en: Damage scaling exists; held attacks, charge curves and self-damage timing require weapon action integration.

note.zh-cn: 需要本地 UI 开关及房间约定；服务端属性无法替所有客机隐藏所有界面。
note.en: Requires per-client HUD controls; server stats cannot hide every client's UI.

interfaces: health fraction conditions; native_buff; corrosion adapter

note.zh-cn: 可按低生命条件施加支持的增益；玩家长期 1 腐化和全套毒花增益需进一步适配。
note.en: Low-health conditions and supported buffs exist; sustained player corruption and complete flower buffs need further work.

note.zh-cn: 刷取任务交互和可近战击破的蝇群实体需要专门资产与交互适配。
note.en: Requires minigame/interaction hooks and a destructible swarm entity with native assets.

note.zh-cn: 可在 Boss 存活条件下请求增援；若要连长招手动作、专属呼叫节奏需接入 AI 行为。
note.en: Boss-conditioned reinforcements are possible; leader animations and native summon cadence need AI integration.

note.zh-cn: 支持普通敌人受限处决及扣韧/生命；玩家首击清空韧性再按近战判死需原生伤害适配。
note.en: Restricted enemy execution and resource damage exist; the exact two-stage player lethal rule requires native damage work.

note.zh-cn: 可调整读取属性的冲击；敌我通用“击飞强度翻倍”还涉及阈值、布娃娃和各攻击配置。
note.en: Stat-consuming impact can change; universal knockback doubling also involves thresholds, ragdolls and attack profiles.

note.zh-cn: no_healing 已实现禁疗；HCM/HED 可编辑编成和增援，但没有统一替换全部普通敌人与新增任务事件。
note.en: no_healing prevents healing; compositions/reinforcements are editable, but universal elite replacement and new mission events are absent.

note.zh-cn: blood_price 提供消耗韧性与攻速、能量、恢复加成；以原生近战 sweep 事件计费。
note.en: blood_price provides toughness cost and speed/power/regen bonuses, charged on native melee sweep events.

note.zh-cn: martyr_blessing 近战击杀回血并在连携时提供短时能量加成。
note.en: martyr_blessing heals on melee kills and maintains a short power effect while coherent.

note.zh-cn: 需受控的音频总线适配；现 sound 动作只播放原生 UI 音效。
note.en: Requires controlled audio-bus integration; current sound actions only play native UI sounds.

note.zh-cn: 需筛选敌人警告与攻击音频事件，不能用全局静音代替。
note.en: Requires filtering enemy warning/attack audio events rather than global muting.

note.zh-cn: 可增加自爆特感请求；仅消除自爆音效仍需音频适配。
note.en: Additional bomber requests are possible; selectively suppressing their sound needs audio work.

interfaces: boss behavior tree; carried minion; animation

note.zh-cn: 抓取、持有并投掷另一敌人是新的复合 AI 动作，现通用接口不覆盖。
note.en: Grabbing and throwing another enemy is a new composite AI action outside the generic interface.

note.zh-cn: 不是已验证的通用 Buff 属性；需人物运动与客户端预测适配。
note.en: Not an audited generic stat; requires locomotion and client-prediction integration.

note.zh-cn: 精确分摊需受击前拦截、保护递归和倒地状态处理；群体伤害动作只能近似。
note.en: Exact sharing needs pre-damage interception, recursion control and downed-state handling.

note.zh-cn: 可有限生成敌人和死亡掉落物；宝藏哥原生逃跑行为与专属单位未开放为自由生成。
note.en: Bounded enemies and drops exist; the special fleeing treasure-carrier behavior/unit is not exposed.

note.zh-cn: 周期调度可用；对玩家雷击并随机变形敌人的复合机制尚需独立适配。
note.en: Scheduling exists; lightning damage plus random enemy transformation requires dedicated work.

note.zh-cn: 可配置部分概率与伤害；精确玩家流血、BOSS 秒杀和绕甲分支未实现。
note.en: Some probabilities/damage are configurable; exact player bleed, boss execution and armor-bypass branches are not.

note.zh-cn: 需要逐敌人清理目标并允许之后重新发现；不等同隐身关键词。
note.en: Requires resetting enemy targets while permitting reacquisition; invisibility is not equivalent.

note.zh-cn: wait_a_moment 暂停许可检查与 HED 30 秒；任务脚本绕行生成不保证停止。
note.en: wait_a_moment pauses permission-gated spawning and HED for 30s; bypassing mission scripts may still spawn.

note.zh-cn: 可以在生成时扣弹和生命；仅针对获救、不影响首次出生的判定尚需救援事件。
note.en: Spawn penalties are possible; distinguishing rescue from initial spawn needs rescue-specific integration.

note.zh-cn: 全近战必暴可表达，但只让重击在原生判暴前必暴需要精确动作时序适配。
note.en: Guaranteed melee crits are expressible; heavy-only crits need classification before the native critical roll.

note.zh-cn: 可用现有原生数值减少生命格；最终最小格数及职业规则由游戏决定。
note.en: Native extra_max_amount_of_wounds can reduce wounds; game/class rules determine the minimum.

note.zh-cn: corrosive_air 实现扣韧与空韧掉血；原图同时压制全部韧性恢复的程度需另配属性。
note.en: corrosive_air drains toughness and then health; full regeneration suppression requires additional stat choices.

note.zh-cn: 需要审计敌方各攻击路径的友伤倍率，不是玩家承伤字段。
note.en: Requires auditing friendly-fire scaling across enemy attack paths, not player damage stats.

note.zh-cn: supply_tax 扣每把武器当前弹药的一半并清空手雷，整数向零取整。
note.en: supply_tax removes half each weapon's current ammunition and all grenades, rounding toward zero.

note.zh-cn: 能改变读取现有属性的玩家爆炸路径；所有敌我和地图爆炸范围/伤害并未统一覆盖。
note.en: Stat-consuming player explosions can change; all enemy/map explosion radii and damage are not uniformly covered.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: 可近似击杀回血后衰减，但缺少独立临时生命池与不会误扣真实生命的消耗规则。
note.en: Kill-heal/decay can approximate it; a separate temporary-health pool and correct consumption order are absent.

note.zh-cn: 受击概率增益可做；按命中次数计数后从互斥增益池抽一项需计数/分支扩展。
note.en: Chance-based reactive effects exist; exact hit-count thresholds and exclusive random buff selection need extensions.

note.zh-cn: field_restoration 按原生限制清腐化再回血；默认在首次观察到单位时执行。
note.en: field_restoration clears corruption then heals under native restrictions, on first observation of a unit.

note.zh-cn: 清腐化和回血可组合；要精确等于某次医疗站的生命格规则需专门医疗站适配。
note.en: Healing/corruption removal can combine; exact station-specific wound rules need a medicae adapter.

note.zh-cn: stillness_blessing 按非疾跑状态提供韧性减伤与能量。
note.en: stillness_blessing applies toughness reduction and power while not sprinting.

note.zh-cn: agility_blessing 提供四项原生属性修正。
note.en: agility_blessing provides all four listed native stat adjustments.

note.zh-cn: melee_shelter 提供 3 秒隐身并加 5 秒冷却；原图无冷却，可自行调整，但仍受原生感知规则。
note.en: melee_shelter adds 3s invisibility with a 5s cooldown; editable, but native perception rules remain.

note.zh-cn: 能修改消费属性的移速和攻速；敌我全动作、换弹切枪及 DOT 结算统一翻倍未实现。
note.en: Movement/attack stat paths can change; universal action/reload/swap/DOT time scaling is not implemented.

note.zh-cn: 可在编队与类别编成中提高罐头比例；原图未给确定比例，需作者选定分配。
note.en: Crusher frequency can be authored in compositions/formations; the image leaves the exact allocation undefined.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: 需要比较邻近玩家腐化比例并施加限定腐化；现条件不支持跨玩家数值公式，也没有施加腐化动作。
note.en: Requires cross-player fraction comparisons and corruption application; neither is currently exposed.

interfaces: model scale; animation; collision; hit zones

note.zh-cn: 缩小玩家涉及外观、碰撞、镜头与命中区；笑话补充不能当作已定义规则。
note.en: Player scaling involves appearance, collision, camera and hit zones; the joke note is not a complete specification.

note.zh-cn: 需更改原生命中区判定；增加弱点伤害不会让下半身自动成为弱点。
note.en: Requires native hit-zone classification changes; weakspot damage bonuses do not create new weakspots.

note.zh-cn: 取消敌人前摇需逐动作审计，不能用攻速倍率保证所有攻击无前摇。
note.en: Removing windups requires per-action timing audits; attack speed does not guarantee zero windup.

note.zh-cn: 可增大散布模拟射击偏差；“任何敌人都打不中”不是可保证的数值效果。
note.en: Spread can simulate inaccurate fire; guaranteed misses against every enemy are not a reliable stat effect.

note.zh-cn: 可按护甲/敌人类型减伤及部分爆炸路径调整；原图武器惩罚的全部路径需逐武器验证。
note.en: Enemy/armor damage penalties and some explosion paths are adjustable; full weapon coverage needs per-weapon validation.

note.zh-cn: 不强制下载安装其他模组；人物替换资源与各端外观同步不属于此数据框架。
note.en: The framework does not force downloads; replacement character assets and client cosmetics are separate work.

note.zh-cn: 图片只有台词，没有确定战斗规则；需先定义随从、语音或效果。
note.en: Only a line of dialogue is supplied; define a companion, audio or combat effect first.

note.zh-cn: 自定义音频资源、全部事件映射和每客户端播放适配尚未提供。
note.en: Custom media, full audio-event replacement and per-client playback are not provided.

note.zh-cn: iron_river 按实际事件伤害恢复等量韧性，含 0.1 秒冷却和原生恢复修正。
note.en: iron_river restores toughness from event damage, with a 0.1s cooldown and native recovery modifiers.

name.zh-cn: 我是答案但问题是什么

note.zh-cn: 需要新增任务交互、题库、暂停/通过规则及多人同步，当前接口不覆盖。
note.en: Needs new checkpoint interactions, puzzle content, progression rules and multiplayer synchronization.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: call_supplies 示例给每人落两箱；随机单人、背包占用检测与直接入槽未实现。
note.en: call_supplies drops both crates by every player; random single-player choice and inventory-aware insertion are absent.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: 部分火焰属性可配；排除魂火且让所有火焰伤害灵能者，需区分火焰来源与友伤许可。
note.en: Some fire stats are configurable; excluding soulblaze while changing all psyker fire exposure needs source/permission adapters.

note.zh-cn: 伤害动作已存在；任务小游戏失误的可靠事件与玩家归属需新增适配。
note.en: Damage action exists; a reliable minigame-error event and player attribution need integration.

note.zh-cn: 现 HED 增援不替换受击单位；需保护任务实体、死亡归属和新旧单位交接。
note.en: HED reinforcement does not replace the damaged unit; ownership and entity handoff need dedicated transformation logic.

note.zh-cn: infinite_test 提供不耗弹、热量增量零和技能冷却 -80%；不等于无限手雷或危机值。
note.en: infinite_test supplies no ammo consumption, zero heat gain and 80% shorter cooldown, not unlimited grenades/peril.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: 可延迟造成邻近生命伤害；真实敌方核弹手雷、爆炸表现和物理抛掷尚未提供。
note.en: Delayed nearby health damage is possible; a real enemy bomb projectile, explosion and physics are absent.

note.zh-cn: 成员变化可由未来适配捕捉；此音频素材和自定义播放接口未提供。
note.en: Membership changes could be adapted; the specific audio asset and custom playback are not provided.

note.zh-cn: 没有触发条件和明确效果，不能推断为可执行词条。
note.en: No trigger or concrete effect is specified.

note.zh-cn: “检测到新三相关内容”缺少可判定条件；静音也需本地音频适配。
note.en: The content-detection rule is undefined; muting also needs a client audio adapter.

interfaces: dodge hit rejection; movement damage reductions

note.zh-cn: 修改闪避距离/余效不能保证移除所有闪避无敌和动作减伤，需逐原生判定适配。
note.en: Distance/linger changes do not remove all dodge rejection and movement reductions; native paths need separate work.

note.zh-cn: 需物品携带与职业判定，接入疾跑/滑铲状态转换；通用移速降低不是等价行为。
note.en: Requires carry/class checks and sprint/slide state transitions; generic slowing is not equivalent.

note.zh-cn: 死亡触发已有；指定音乐素材、授权来源与各端播放属于外部资源适配。
note.en: The death trigger exists; the named track and per-client playback require external media integration.

note.zh-cn: 可利用原生倒地事件，但指定歌曲播放未提供。
note.en: Native downed events can be used, but playback of the specified song is not provided.

note.zh-cn: 需要新可携带物、计时爆炸、掉落/转移与多人所有权，超出现有 pickup 动作。
note.en: Needs a custom pocketable, timed explosion, transfer/drop rules and multiplayer ownership.

note.zh-cn: mixed_stimms 附加能量、速度、技能药剂；未把所有治疗药剂的即时治疗行为一并复刻。
note.en: mixed_stimms adds power, speed and ability stims; it does not reproduce every instant healing-stim behavior.

note.zh-cn: 不耗弹关键词可近似；“仍耗备用弹但免换弹”的严格版本需自动弹匣供弹适配。
note.en: No-ammo-consumption can approximate it; consuming reserves while bypassing reload needs clip-feed integration.

note.zh-cn: 需要视频资源、播放 UI 和各端退出清理，当前框架不加载外部视频。
note.en: Requires video assets, playback UI and client cleanup; external video is not loaded by this framework.

note.zh-cn: 可组合数值惩罚，但“肌无力”没有给出具体属性与幅度。
note.en: Numerical penalties are possible, but the affected stats and magnitudes are unspecified.

note.zh-cn: deadeye_recoil 将原生后坐倍率降为零；其他瞄准晃动仍按原生处理。
note.en: deadeye_recoil removes the native recoil multiplier; other aim motion remains native.

note.zh-cn: 没有可实现的明确规则；若指人物变武器，需要独立玩法和资产。
note.en: No concrete rule is defined; a literal transformation needs a separate mode and assets.

note.zh-cn: “能做任何事”没有可验收的范围，不能作为接口实现承诺。
note.en: Unlimited capability is not a testable specification.

interfaces: chat messaging policy; game rule specification

note.zh-cn: 没有实现自动辱骂或替玩家发言；可另行定义不发送聊天消息的对战规则。
note.en: Automatic insults or speaking for players are not implemented; a combat rule without chat transmission could be specified separately.

note.zh-cn: 未提供具体效果；不推测或生成隐藏规则。
note.en: No concrete effect supplied; no hidden behavior inferred.

note.zh-cn: undead_hunter 对这两类原生行尸增加 50% 伤害；特殊变异行尸可自行补目录 ID。
note.en: undead_hunter adds 50% against these two native breeds; add other mutated variants explicitly if desired.

note.zh-cn: 可组合多数数值惩罚和暂停类别；仅随机可抽、排斥全部其他词条、移除闪避滑铲和全敌人行为缩放尚需扩展。
note.en: Most stat penalties and family pauses can combine; random-only selection, exclusion of all other entries, movement-state removal and universal AI scaling need extensions.

note.zh-cn: labour_melee 按命中事件扣体力，空体力短时减攻速/伤害；有 0.05 秒节流，密集多目标命中不会逐个无限计费。
note.en: labour_melee spends stamina on hits and applies empty-stamina penalties; 0.05s throttling prevents unbounded per-target charging.

note.zh-cn: 需要全新的可操作载具及地图适配，不是普通天赋或 Buff 字段。
note.en: Requires a controllable vehicle, physics, networking and map support, not a normal talent field.
